version_note: Researched 2026-11-21 for PoE 2 patch 0.5.5 (Forbidden Rites event league, live 2026-09-04, alongside Runes of Aldur). Sources say 1.0 launches 2026-12-11 (not 12-04) and GGG is holding big balance changes for 1.0, so re-check everything after 1.0. GGG has not added true 'Uber' pinnacle bosses in 0.5.x; 'uber' entries here are the harder repeat/empowered versions. No source publishes per-hit damage for 0.5.x bosses, so every max_hit check is an estimate (confidence low). Check meaning: value >= min = ready; risky_below <= value < min = risky; value < risky_below = not yet.

general.why: Default max resistance is 75%; maps and bosses are balanced around capped elemental resistance.
general.source: Maxroll: PoE2 Defence guide (updated 2026-09-18) <https://maxroll.gg/poe2/getting-started/defence-guide>; Timesaver: T15 map DPS requirement (0.5.5, 2026-09-08) <https://timesaver.gg/blog/poe2-t15-dps-requirement-0-5-5>

general.why: Max-res modifiers can raise the cap to at most 90%. Overcapping max fire/lightning helps for the Arbiters.

general.threshold: -10% per act step: Act 2 -10, Act 3 -20, Act 4 -30, interludes -40 / -50, endgame (area level 65+) -60
general.why: PoB already includes the penalty for the chosen act/endgame setting; check PoB is set to endgame. (0.4/0.5 campaign layout; 1.0 adds campaign content, so re-check after 1.0.)
general.source: PoE2 Wiki: Maximum Resistances (act penalty table; read via search snippet, site blocks bots) <https://www.poe2wiki.net/wiki/Maximum_Resistances>

general.threshold: >= 0 always; 20-30% for mixed or chaos fights
general.why: The wiki says campaign negative resistance is not applied to chaos res, and chaos res is consistent across the endgame. Chaos damage removes twice as much ES, so ES builds need it more. 20-30% figure is an estimate.
general.source: PoE2 Wiki: Chaos resistance <https://www.poe2wiki.net/wiki/Chaos_resistance>; Maxroll: PoE2 Defence guide (updated 2026-09-18) <https://maxroll.gg/poe2/getting-started/defence-guide>; 20-30% is estimated

general.why: Maxroll: stay above at least 30% elemental res during the campaign.

general.threshold: 100K barely / 200K-500K comfortable / 1M+ juiced and pinnacle prep
general.why: Timesaver's own estimates; GGG publishes no figure.

general.source: Switchblade Gaming: Pinnacle boss minimum HP and DPS thresholds (verified vs 0.5.2) <https://www.switchbladegaming.com/path-of-exile-2/endgame-boss-guide/>

general.threshold: 3,000 entry / 4,000 mid / 5,000 hard / 6,000 apex (life); about double as ES
general.why: Switchblade tiers; Switchblade itself calls them heuristics.
general.source: Switchblade Gaming: Pinnacle boss minimum HP and DPS thresholds (verified vs 0.5.2) <https://www.switchbladegaming.com/path-of-exile-2/endgame-boss-guide/>

general.why: Timesaver gives ~3,000+ EHP as a bare minimum; raised to 4,000 to be conservative. Players report juiced T15-16 trash hitting for 3-5k.
general.source: Timesaver: T15 map DPS requirement (0.5.5, 2026-09-08) <https://timesaver.gg/blog/poe2-t15-dps-requirement-0-5-5>; Steam community discussion: juiced T15-16 hits (anecdotes) <https://steamcommunity.com/app/2694490/discussions/0/598514944991864195>; 4,000 is estimated

general.check: max hit per type for red maps
general.why: Estimated from player reports of 3-5k hits from juiced trash; no published guideline exists.

general.threshold: armour = 12x the hit for 50% reduction (6x: 33%, 36x: 75%; max 90%)
general.why: Damage Reduction = Armour / (Armour + 12 x hit). Use PoB's max physical hit, which already includes this.
